status: TEMPLATE: not registered. The grader fills every <...> and every null below, sets this to "registered", and commits the file before any counted data exists. gym/run.py refuses a counted run until then.
title: Example: the answers are the medians, and beat the mean
written_by: <the grader's badge id: never the builder's, never the manager who directed the build>
written_before: <proof that no counted data existed, e.g. 'gym/series/G1.json held no point'>
question: <Does the thing under test do the task, as it ships?>
null: the mean of each unit's values: the strongest answer that knows nothing the thing under test is meant to know
unit_of_inference: one distinct list of values; a list seen twice counts once
statistic: headline = percent of units answered right; delta = answers minus the null, in points, paired by unit
estimator: paired bootstrap resampling distinct units, B = 2000, seed 0 (gym_kit.paired_bootstrap)

min_n.comment: the grader sets this before any counted data: the fewest units a verdict may rest on

bars.comment: the grader sets the threshold before any counted data; it never moves after

bars.what: the CI lower bound of the delta is above 0: the answers beat the null

vetoes.name: padding
vetoes.what: a repeated list counts once; a list of fewer than 3 values is skipped and counted

controls.name: rotated_key
controls.expect: the answers score at most 20 percent against the truth rotated by one unit

controls.name: grader_selfcheck
controls.expect: the true key scores 100 and an all-wrong key 0, every run

controls.name: stand_in
controls.expect: the artifacts come from the contract's command
controls.void_if: a counted run graded the lane's stand-in

controls.name: blast_radius
controls.expect: git status is clean after the run

decision_rule.VOID: any control fails, or the artifact is missing (report n = 0)
decision_rule.FAIL: b1 fails, or the CI of the delta lies below 0
decision_rule.PASS: b1 holds and the CI of the delta lies above 0
decision_rule.MARGINAL: b1 holds and the CI of the delta straddles 0

contract.comment: Once the builder's contract exists, the grader reads it and pins it here: path = "gym/contracts/G1-artifacts.md" (from the checkout's top), sha256 = the sha256 of that file as read. A later change to the contract is pinned by a dated amendment, never by editing this block.
